correctness.rationale: Directly square the specified bilinear graphical-group multiplication in characteristic two; group central coordinates contribute q^m. Nonzero edge labels force an induced positive-edge support and its closed-neighbourhood zeros. Free outside support is enumerated by weighted independent sets. The vertex-edge multiplicative homomorphism has kernel size q-1 exactly on bipartite connected components and size 1 on odd-cycle components, since q-1 is odd. This proves the complete formula and the image polynomial. A separate brute-force program checked all 24 finite graph/field target spaces, including F4 and F8, and exactly reproduced every fiber, image cardinality and identity fiber.
